605:       *
606:       * If `root` is defined, the target is a hierarchical path starting from `root`.
607:       *
608:       * If `root` is not defined, the target is a hierarchical path equivalent to `toAbsoluteTarget`.
609:       *
610:       * @note If `root` is defined, and has not finished elaboration, this must be called within `atModuleBodyEnd`.
611:       * @note The BaseModule must be a descendant of `root`, if it is defined.
612:       * @note This doesn't have special handling for Views.
613:       */
614:     final def toRelativeTarget(root: Option[BaseModule]): IsModule = {
615:       (root, _parent) match {
616:         // If root was defined, and we are it, return this.
617:         case (Some(definedRoot), _) if definedRoot == this => getTarget
618:         // If there is a parent, recurse up.
619:         case (_, Some(parent)) => parent.toRelativeTarget(root).instOf(this.instanceName, name)
620:         // If we are at a ViewParent, use its absolute target.
621:         case (_, None) if this == ViewParent => ViewParent.absoluteTarget
622:         // If root was defined, and there is no parent, the root was not an ancestor.
623:         case (Some(definedRoot), None) =>
624:           throwException(s"Requested .toRelativeTarget relative to ${definedRoot.name}, but it is not an ancestor")
625:         // If root was not defined, and there is no parent, return this.
626:         case (None, None) => getTarget
627:       }
628:     }

630:     /**
631:       * Internal API. Returns a list of this module's generated top-level ports as a map of a String
632:       * (FIRRTL name) to the IO object. Only valid after the module is closed.
633:       *
634:       * Note: for BlackBoxes (but not ExtModules), this returns the contents of the top-level io
635:       * object, consistent with what is emitted in FIRRTL.
636:       *
637:       * TODO: Use SeqMap/VectorMap when those data structures become available.
638:       */
639:     private[chisel3] def getChiselPorts(implicit si: SourceInfo): Seq[(String, Data)] = {
640:       require(_closed, "Can't get ports before module close")
641:       modulePortsAskedFor = Some(si) // super-lock down the module
642:       (_component.get.ports ++ _component.get.secretPorts).map { port =>
643:         (port.id.getRef.asInstanceOf[ModuleIO].name, port.id)
644:       }
645:     }
